description: This file defines a report parser class for generating crossovered budget reports in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for calculating budget figures and totals.

classes.name: budget_report
classes.description: Report parser class for crossovered budget report, providing methods to compute budget data and totals.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context with functions and variables.

methods.name: funct
methods.description: Calculates detailed budget figures for each analytic account within specified date range and report type.

methods.name: funct_total
methods.description: Returns total budget figures accumulated across all processed data.
